observations.observation: Replacement installation preserves progress from the preceding level-4 Continue and resumes the shaped fifth board. No first-entry tutorial appears in this restored attempt.
The first normal swap starts cascades, replenishes the shaped board and naturally produces a vertical rocket.
Swapping a naturally created rocket triggers board powers and normal cascades.
A stale screenshot-based candidate is invalid on the actual board. The swap returns and the visible board and counters are retained. This OS gesture is explicitly excluded from accepted-move counts.
A direct OS tap activates the naturally generated vertical rocket, removes grass and consumes one move.
An ordinary blue match creates another propeller in the cleared left portion of the board.
An OS swipe combines an adjacent natural propeller and vertical rocket. The combination and subsequent cascades remove 12 grass targets while charging a single move.
The final direct propeller tap spends the original thirtieth move. After its resolution the board displays the automatic Out of Moves banner and a worried/sad King; no skip input is sent.
The banner leaves automatically and the Level 5 / Level Failed / Try Again popup appears. Later 9, 13, 18 and 22-second captures have the same image hash.
The actual Try Again button starts a fresh fifth-level attempt, rebuilds all grass targets and restores the King idle pose.
A following ordinary swap clears three red pieces and grass, refills the board and consumes one move. The retry is playable.

video_observations.observation: The blue banner descends below its eventual resting line, rebounds above it, returns to center, holds, anticipates upward on exit and leaves downward before the failure popup. Edge-run centers on the sampled video are a visual locator, not actual transform or Unity time values.

limits: This production APK includes the committed native banner direction, 0.1-second settling and typed active-level-clock fix. Android internal clock/transform state is not instrumented; native construction/ease/quantization ports and actual Unity flow measurements remain in out_of_moves_banner_evidence.json.

The first attempt intentionally spends legal moves mainly in the already cleared left area to reach ordinary budget exhaustion with goals remaining. Thirty moves are consumed through real input, with no board, power, save or move-budget injection. One invalid OS swap returns without consuming a move.
The screenshot color classifier only helps select gestures. It requires manual special-piece review, misclassifies a stale candidate once, and is not shipped in the APK or used as native/model proof.

The visible banner path and popup transition are behavioral observations of the recovery APK. The screen recording is downscaled, contains no audio and does not establish exact original renderer, scheduler, frame timing or input parity.

This round covers an ordinary fifth-level failure and playable retry. It does not naturally complete all 100 levels, run the Android bonus/Jester scene, cold-restart this revision or validate a physical ARM64 device.
The original-app first-run terms/privacy confirmation and the unrelated user phone/editor remain untouched. Original-device image/audio/input parity remains unverified.
